notes.title: Update 0.9.0d
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- [b]Grow plants from seed[/b]: Grow plants from seed in the seed tray. Seeds take one turn to sprout. Seeds grow with a little variance, sometimes stronger or weaker. Once they've sprouted, you can move them into your garden/deck or purge them.
- [b]Plants grow over time and with high power plays[/b]: Plants gain growth points over time. Plants also gain growth points when played at high power. When enough growth points have been accumulated, plants will grow/upgrade.
- [b]Earn seeds from battles[/b]: Choose 1 of 3 seed packs to add to your inventory after each battle.
- [b]Totems[/b]: Introduced totems that you can use to modify plants in a row/column of your garden.
- [b]New Tools[/b]: Have a number of removals every turn. Start the first turn with Borrowed Time and gain an extra turn. More tools coming soon!
- [b]Opening cutscene[/b]: Added a sneak peek of the narrative with the opening cutscene.
- [b]Seasons Reworked[/b]: Seasons have been adjusted to suit the new gardening mechanics.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Heal to full between battles. We've reworked base difficulty for full heals between battle.
- Plants have rarities.
- Nasturtium has been simplified - it doesn't start with making the drawn card free to play.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fix tutorial says you have 2 removes when you have 3 - found by @lnnocentbystndr 
- Fix Nasturtium claiming it can draw withered cards - found by @lnnocentbystndr 
- Fix hard lock out when the map generates a Maw -> Train run - found by @qwerty59 
- Fix missing hovers in Growth Event modals - found by @qwerty59 
- Fix Lunar Thyme having targeting - Found by @qwerty59

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
- I have unfortunately [b]broken run saves[/b] in this latest update
- The [b]Journal has been removed[/b] as it needs a rework with gardening changes

[i]Lots of changes are bundled in this update, and I'm unable to list all of them. Highlighted here are the biggest changes from the last demo update.[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.8.2h
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- [b]Run saves[/b]: your run progress now saves at the beginning of battle and the beginning of gardening (suggested by many!!)
- Preview your deck in the garden (suggested by @arkuktor)
- View Journal in the Main Menu (suggested by @lnnocentbystndr)

[h2]Polish[/h2]
- Allow toggling between vendor options

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fix inconsistent water refund in Season of Plenty (found by @lnnocentbystndr)

notes.title: Update 0.8.2g
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- Add smart drawing, where the currently playing card doesn't count towards total hand size (Suggested by @vetres3)
- If you lose all your health in the same play that kills all enemies, you win and are healed to 1 health (Suggested by @cychloryn)
- Fountains water at the end of the turn, not the start (Suggested by @dead3y3_yt)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fix master volume resets to full every time you open the game (Found by @tomadto)
- Fix garden items don't count towards Season of Power (Found by @cychloryn )
- Fix UI says high power even when you skip over it (Found by @cychloryn and Joe)
- Fix garden items block hearts of plants above (Found by @atranimal and Joe)
- Fix FPS target dropdown visually resets, but target doesn't actually reset (Found by @tomadto)
- Fix SFX volume slider doesn't affect all SFX (Found by @tomadto)
- Fix some card descriptions don't fit on screen by moving cards higher on hover (Found by @cychloryn and @dead3y3_yt)
- Fix X.5 effects don't always match card description (Found by @mysticuno, Zeawen, and Dee)
- Fix strength depleted by plant that adds strength and does attack, even if no strength was used by the plant (Found by Zeawen)
- Fix Season of Plenty not unlocking when exactly 30 plants are discovered (Found by @lnnocentbystndr)
- Fix hovering mouse below garden causes tiles to freak out (Found by @atranimal)

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- The Changing Tide boss health reduced 160 -> 120. And move Slams does 28 -> 24 damage. This is a balance change to make the demo more accessible.

notes.title: Update 0.8.2e
notes.notes:
- Fix softlock where after winning a run, the next run would get softlocked after the first battle (found by @vetres3 and @dead3y3_yt)
- Fix text on Power tooltip for the Maw being confusing (found by @vetres3)
- Fix text on Strength tooltip being confusing (found by @dead3y3_yt)
- Fix redundant season unlock even when you have already unlocked it
- Optimistic fix for not being able to water or use trowel, even after selection (found by phil)

notes.title: Update 0.8.2d

[list]

[list]

[*] Fix Mint Buds text has an additional ")"
[*] Don't let you soft lock yourself in the tutorial by rerolling (found by spikyhwang)
[*] Reset the garden tutorial if you leave the run mid-tutorial (found by spikyhwang)
